picks.headline: Suno explores a developer API to open generative music to third-party apps
picks.rationale: Highest-novelty platform shift: Suno opening a curated developer API could reshape how creative tools embed AI song generation — a structural change makers should track now.
picks.excerpt: Suno CPO Jack Brody says the AI-music company is exploring a developer API, starting with a curated set of partners, to let apps build new interactive experiences on top of generative music. A platform-capability shift that could reshape how creative tools embed AI song generation.

picks.headline: Techivation's M-Compressor 2 adds an AI Mix Assistant that dials in compression
picks.rationale: Actionable craft upgrade: an AI Mix Assistant that analyses audio and generates tailored compression settings speeds up an everyday mixing chore for producers tomorrow.
picks.excerpt: Techivation's M-Compressor 2 adds an intelligent Mix Assistant that analyses incoming audio and generates 12 tailored compression settings, collapsing the plugin's controls into a single blendable macro. An AI-assist angle on the everyday mixing chore of dialling in compression.
